name: Margazhi Music Festival & Dance Season
description: World-famous Carnatic music and Classical Bharatanatyam festival held across sabhas in Mylapore and T. Nagar. Heavy footfalls and parking congestion during evening performances (4 PM - 9 PM).

name: Pongal Harvest Festival & Marina Beach Gathering
description: Kaanum Pongal mass gatherings on Marina Beach and Elliot's Beach. Over 100,000 visitors; Kamarajar Salai (Beach Road) converted to pedestrian-only with heavy police traffic diversions.

name: Kapaleeshwarar Panguni Peruvizha & Arubathimoovar Procession
description: Grand 63 Nayanmars chariot procession around Mylapore temple tank streets. Massive spiritual crowds; traffic strictly diverted from Luz Church Road and Kutchery Road.

name: Velankanni Church Festival (Besant Nagar)
description: Annual feast of Our Lady of Good Health shrine at Besant Nagar. Heavy vehicular traffic along Besant Avenue and Elliot's Beach promenade.
